0.name: TEXT_REGGYR3ALAGHIRI_00399_DIGGIN_000_000
0.description: If you have something to ask me, make it quick. I'm on patrol.

3.name: TEXT_REGGYR3ALAGHIRI_00399_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGGYR3ALAGHIRI_00399_DIGGIN_000_010
5.description: My name is Diggin. I'm one of the Ala Mhigan Resistance tasked with keeping this town safe.

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3ALAGHIRI_00399_DIGGIN_000_011
6.description: That being said, I do not plan on merely protecting it. Ala Ghiri's suffered under the Empire for twenty years; I'd like to do my part to help them rebuild.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR3ALAGHIRI_00399_DIGGIN_000_020
7.description: This is Ala Ghiri. It was a popular stop on the trade route to the Far East before the Empire took the village for their own.

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR3ALAGHIRI_00399_DIGGIN_000_021
8.description: The trade route went the same way as Ala Ghiri's freedom. The village has only managed to survive the past few decades by trading with imperial troops.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR3ALAGHIRI_00399_DIGGIN_000_022
9.description: No one will be trading by land with the Far East as long as the Empire draws breath; however, there is hope yet for Ala Ghiri if they increase trade with Ul'dah and Gridania.
